name: NeighborFridge
tagline: Tracks groceries from receipts, reminds you before they expire and lets neighbours claim the extras.
problem: Groceries spoil in student fridges, wasting money and resources.
solution: Receipt OCR lists items and estimates expiry dates, email reminders fire before spoilage, and a local marketplace lets neighbours claim or buy surplus food.
demo_moment: Team-described: scan a receipt, get expiry estimates, then post an item to the marketplace.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Figma Make Challenge” and “Best UI/UX” among 307 submissions.
Used Figma Make for moodboards and UI planning before coding.
Won Best UI/UX as well as the Figma Make prize.

lessons: A coherent visual identity can win design prizes for a simple product.
